title: COMP Extensions Page
summary: Official Derivative common-parameter page reference for Component extension parameters, including reinitialization, initialization on start, extension object/name/promote fields, and direct versus .ext access.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python or parameter plans need to configure the built-in Extensions page on a COMP.

Set ext0object to code that returns a Python object, ext0name when the extension should be searched by a custom name, and ext0promote when capitalized members should be visible directly on the component.
Pulse reinitextensions when extension objects must be rebuilt after code or object-parameter changes.
Use initextonstart when a component's extension objects should reinitialize automatically when TouchDesigner starts.
If ext0promote is off, access extension members through .ext instead of at component level.
